facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for an Instagram Post
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing creative energy to your brand. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you, built around the idea of honoring your Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for your coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to your producers. Essentially, the post would showcase your commitment to quality and the impact of your partnerships, while also highlighting the unique customer experience you foster at your cafes. It would involve a visually appealing post that captures the essence of your mission, paired with a thoughtful message that invites your team to share their perspective and engage with your audience.

The post would be a collaborative effort, where we'd work together to craft a post that emphasizes your dedication to quality and the producers you support, while also celebrating the customer experience at your cafes. We'd aim to create a post that resonates with your audience and further reinforces your commitment to your producers.

Reply if you're interested in exploring this opportunity further.

The BrandPilot team
